title: Lab - Manage LVM
description: Build a volume group, carve a volume, and grow it online.
scenario: Build a volume group, carve a volume, and grow it online. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create
tasks.instructions: Make /dev/sdd and /dev/sde physical volumes, group them as vg_data, and create a 2 GiB LV lv_app.
tasks.solution:
pvcreate /dev/sdd /dev/sde
vgcreate vg_data /dev/sdd /dev/sde
lvcreate -L 2G -n lv_app vg_data

tasks.title: Task 2 - Use
tasks.instructions: Format lv_app as ext4 and mount it at /app.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Grow
tasks.instructions: Extend lv_app by 1 GiB and grow the filesystem without unmounting.
